transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you to see me?

Um, hi. I guess the main reason I came in is just... I get pulled off track pretty easily. Like, if I get a Slack ping, or even just hear a song lyric, I kind of lose the thread of what I'm supposed to be doing. 

If I'm trying to finish a dashboard for a project or something, a random idea for something else will pop up and I just... forget what I was working on. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Did you experience these kinds of focus problems back when you were a child, or is this something that started more recently?

Um... yeah, I guess it's been around for a while. 

Even back in, like, elementary school, my teachers would write stuff on my report cards about it. Like how I rushed through worksheets, or... didn't follow directions. I guess I talked over kids during group work, too. 

And, um, my parents had to sit with me when I did homework. Because if they didn't, I'd just wander off or start doing something else before I was done. So... yeah, it's not new.
Do you often feel physically restless or fidgety, or like you have an internal urge to constantly be on the go?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like if I'm stuck on a long Zoom call, or just have to sit quietly in one place... I start getting this kind of uncomfortable pressure in my body. 

It just feels like I really need to get up and pace around, or... at least do something with my hands. So... yeah.
